changes.summaryEn: Correct Duel timing, withdrawal and stakes against the LionWing PDF; expose the conflicting player Wound counts as a Narrator ruling.
corrections: Bail: neither participant takes the stake; it is not accepting defeat.
Resolve combat Duel immediately when no other enemies or no other allies remain.
Unstructured loser becomes Vulnerable before the listed consequences.
Printed page 38 says 1 Wound; printed page 62 says 2 Wounds. This discrepancy is visible in the PDF, not an extraction error.
